en: Black-and-white image showing a brick civic-style building with a steep, slate-like roof and a flagpole flying a light-colored flag with a darker edge or band. The façade has arched windows, decorative stonework, and a small balcony. In front of the building is a narrow river or canal with landscaped banks, and a small road bridge crossing it. A horse-drawn carriage and a cyclist are on the bridge. Dense trees and foliage surround the scene, giving it a park-like setting.
